description: Get a curated, step-by-step guide for a common Orderly development task such as wallet connection, deposits, SDK setup, or placing orders. Returns exactly one best-matching workflow as Markdown with prerequisites, numbered steps, TypeScript examples, common issues, and related workflows; pass the task in natural language or a partial name, and a miss lists available workflows. Read-only lookup from bundled data — no network calls, credentials, rate limits, or side effects. Use for end-to-end tasks, not one-off lookups: get_component_guide for a known UI component, search_orderly_docs (scope 'sdk') for symbols, get_api_info for core endpoints, and the matching named tool for Indexer, Public Info, Orderly One, or Strategy Vault data.

workflow.description: Workflow topic, name fragment, or natural-language description (e.g., 'wallet connection', 'deposit', 'setting up react sdk', 'placing orders'). Matches are fuzzy — partial words and multi-word queries work.

name: explain_workflow
